$comment: Fields v1 (spec pass S1 draft, 2026-11-02; docs/design/spec-s1-water.md sections 2-7, 11, 12). DRAFT: not loaded yet; the implementer moves it to data/rules/ with a schema. Integers only. Units: mm, um (micrometres), um/s, mm/s, L/s, ticks at 20 per second, permille, wetness and mud on 0-65535. depthSpeed is depth mm x flow mm/s / 1000 (mm*m/s; 600 = 0.6 m2/s). Settled from the brief: deep or fast water is lethal and closed, shallow water and mud are slow but open (2026-10-09); soldiers never walk into lethal cells and react only to what is lethal now (2026-10-09, 2026-10-11). Grid facts from the code and plan: 1.5 m cells, fields every 4 ticks on active tiles. Everything else is a proposal, hence status placeholder.

water.$comment: Virtual pipes (tech notes section 5). Two substeps per field step keep sqrt(g*h)*dt under half a cell to about 5.7 m depth. pipeGainPermille = g*dt/cell = 9.81*0.1/1.5. Damping is a friction stand-in, tuned so the M3 river runs about 0.5-1.0 m/s at base flow.

mapWater.$comment: Sources add a constant discharge evenly over their cells; sinks are free outflow (outside surface = edge ground height); other edges are closed. Maps ship a settled depth and flux layer baked offline by the same kernel. A channel whose bed lies below an adjacent tick-0 water surface counts as filled to that surface for the reachability check.

wetness.$comment: 1 um absorbed = 2 wetness units, so full (65535) is about 32.8 mm absorbed. Infiltration from rain or standing water (>= dry depth) at 1 mm/s. Drying only without surface water: full to dry in about 10 minutes, longer than a 3-minute battle. Heat drying is reserved for S3.

mud.$comment: No traffic field in M3: churn writes mud directly. base(w) = max(0, w - baseStart); cap(w) = max(0, w - capStart) * capNum / capDen; mud = clamp(max(base, mud + churn), 0, cap * soil.capPermille / 1000). Churn per moving unit per field step = churnWeight[class] * churnAtFullWetness * soil.churnPermille / 1000 * max(0, w - capStart) / (65535 - capStart). About five 200-strong infantry regiments take a road cell from soft to deep.

soils.$comment: Firm road: gets soft, never deep.

movement.$comment: Speed in permille, linear between points. Cost multiplier = 1000000 / speed permille. maxEnterDepthMm: deeper is closed to the class's own steering. Swept (lethal, closed): depth >= sweptDepthMm, or depth >= sweptMinDepthMm and depthSpeed >= sweptDepthSpeed. Ford limits from terrain-weather brainstorm #7 (wheeled 0.5 m, horse 1.2 m); horses stand deeper but current takes them sooner (tech notes section 5). Per-unit-type armour modifiers wait for S2. Flow-field water costs refresh at most once per refreshTicks per dirty tile, with a 100 mm hysteresis; the per-tick lethal check in movement is immediate.

swept.$comment: Swept soldiers drift with the flow and paddle toward the nearest cell where they could regain footing (below regainPermille of both thresholds); the drowning timer runs. Bank exit: stunned, then rejoin; the timer resets. Swept soldiers stay in their regiment's outline for the range rule (decision D9). Cold-water timers come with ice in S3.

causeTags.$comment: Decision D7: water carries the cause of its most recent adder, per tile. Rain stamps its cast id on the tiles of its area while it rains; springs stamp their piece id; base river water is map:river. A tile takes a neighbour's newer tag when the net inflow from it exceeds adoptInflowUm (averaged over the tile) in one field step; ties go to the larger inflow, then the lower tile index. 'river overflowed' fires once per tile when a cell first turns lethal for foot that was not lethal at tick 0; 'regiment swept' at most once per regiment per sweptEventCooldownTicks.
